note: kEUR per MW per year. forward: day-ahead value over the Cal strip, rebuilt from each day's forwards. realised: per delivery day, EUR per MW per day in each market and the best one (not a stack). rl_da / co_rl: the same without perfect foresight (scheduled on the 7 previous days' average prices, paid at the day's own); *_ratio: what they keep of the perfect value, same days.
